title: Tls.SecurePair has been removed
summary: Node.js removed tls.SecurePair (DEP0043: documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime deprecation since v8.0.0, end-of-life since v24.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of tls.SecurePair with tls.TLSSocket.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
